generator.program.note: The lineage's own program (growth plan G2.3a), on the herb base: it gives the values its species leave unset, which the herb program gave as defaults until then.

traits.note: Plants of the World Online's account of the family, as search results quote it (the page itself was not read): flowers usually actinomorphic, less commonly zygomorphic (as in Aconitum); sepals (3-)5 to 8, often petaloid; stamens numerous, usually spirally arranged; carpels one to many, usually free; ovary superior.

traits.woodiness.note: Hutchinson (vol. 1, 2nd ed., 1959), families 249 Ranunculaceae (buttercups, anemones, Clematis) and 248 Helleboraceae (hellebores, columbines, larkspurs), which APG joins as Ranunculaceae: mostly perennial or annual herbs with basal and alternate leaves, a few shrubs or climbers (Clematis) with opposite leaves; stipules absent or only sheathing bases of the leaf stalk; fruit a cluster of dry achenes in the first, follicles in the second.

traits.rosette.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Ranunculaceae as that work draws it, there coded together with Hydrastidaceae: whether the leaves gather in rosettes (character 22), coded often a basal rosette, often no rosette. Read from the coded states by script (spec-rework/b1/delta/mapdelta.py with character 21 added); states the authors do not qualify, side by side, read as often.

traits.life_span.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Ranunculaceae as that work draws it, there coded together with Hydrastidaceae: the herbs' life form (character 21), coded often annual, often biennial, often perennial. Read from the coded states by script (spec-rework/b1/delta/mapdelta.py with character 21 added); states the authors do not qualify, side by side, read as often.
